authoritativePatronIdentity.name: Fiend Patron
authoritativePatronIdentity.sourceNote: 2014 subclass chooses Fiend at level 1; 2024 source describes subclass at level 3. Native Patron identity still begins at level 1; the timing of granted powers is separate.

parts.name: Fiend Spell Access
parts.common: Patron alters spells available to the Warlock.
differences: 2014 adds spell choices to the Warlock spell list without automatically granting them; 2024 grants specified spells via always-prepared terminology, requiring the approved native no-daily-preparation conversion.
The two spell lists are not identical.
2014 source feature appears at Warlock 1; 2024 at Warlock 3.

parts.name: Dark One's Blessing
parts.common: Temporary Hit Points equal to Charisma modifier plus Warlock class level, minimum 1, when a qualifying enemy is reduced to 0 Hit Points.
differences: 2014: Warlock personally reduces a hostile creature to 0 HP.
2024: also triggers when another creature reduces an enemy within 10 feet of the Warlock to 0 HP.

parts.name: Dark One's Own Luck
parts.common: At Warlock level 6, add 1d10 to an ability check or saving throw after the roll and before its effects.
differences: 2014: one use, restored after Short or Long Rest.
2024: Charisma modifier uses (minimum one), no more than once per roll; all uses restored after Long Rest.

parts.name: Fiendish Resilience (Fiend Patron)
parts.common: At Warlock level 10, select a damage type at the end of a Short or Long Rest and gain Resistance until changed on a later rest.
differences: 2014: magical or silvered weapon damage ignores this Resistance, no force-damage exclusion is stated.
2024: cannot select Force damage; no magical/silvered weapon bypass is stated.
Distinct from previously approved historical Warlock BASE CLASS fast healing; the owner has reopened that base-class grant for review. The Patron resistance feature remains independent.

parts.name: Hurl Through Hell
parts.common: At Warlock level 14, on a qualifying attack hit, send a creature through the Lower Planes and return it at the end of the next turn; damage is Psychic for non-Fiends.
differences: 2014: no saving throw, deals 10d10 damage on return, once per Long Rest.
2024: Charisma saving throw negates the effect; on a failure deals 8d10 on application and Incapacitates until return; once per Long Rest, but expending a Pact Magic slot can restore a use.
The native ruling must resolve saving throw, damage timing/dice, status, and slot-spending recovery together.

openNativeDecisions.question: Which Fiend powers, if any, begin at Warlock level 1 in the authoritative native progression (beyond identity)?
openNativeDecisions.resolution: Use the 2014 Fiend level-1 mechanical milestone: Dark One's Blessing and Patron spell access accompany Fiend Patron selection at class level 1. Blessing trigger is approved in its 2024 form; Fiend spell entitlement mode and spell roster remain unresolved. Preserve both source-era projections for provenance.

openNativeDecisions.question: Which source spell lists and spell-access grants are unified, and what native entitlement replaces source always-prepared versus expanded-choice rules?
At the established native level-1 grant, adopt the 2014 self-defeat trigger or 2024 expanded nearby-other-creature trigger?
openNativeDecisions.resolution: At Warlock level 1, grant temporary HP equal to max(1, Charisma modifier + Warlock level) when the Warlock reduces a hostile creature to 0 HP, or when another creature reduces an enemy within 10 feet of the Warlock to 0 HP, following the 2024 expanded cooperative trigger and ordinary nonstacking temporary-HP rules.

openNativeDecisions.question: Recovery cadence remains open: 2024 Long Rest refill is recommended; 2014 used a single use restored after Short/Long Rest. Do not silently treat Charisma modifier uses as recharging on every Short Rest.
openNativeDecisions.resolution: At Warlock level 6, Dark One's Own Luck adds 1d10 to an ability check or saving throw after the roll and before its effects, at most once per roll; uses equal max(1, Charisma modifier) and all expended uses recover on a Long Rest. Approves the previously recommended 2024 recovery schedule.

openNativeDecisions.question: Select force eligibility and magical/silvered damage bypass rules?
Resolve save, 10d10 versus 8d10, damage timing, Incapacitated, and Pact-slot recovery.
openNativeDecisions.resolution: At Warlock level 14, once per turn on a qualifying attack-roll hit, expend a use to force the target to make a Charisma saving throw against Warlock spell save DC. On failure, transport it through the Lower Planes, immediately deal 8d10 Psychic damage if the target is not a Fiend, and apply Incapacitated until it returns at the end of the Warlock's next turn. A use returns after a Long Rest; expending a Pact Magic spell slot can restore a use. A successful save still consumes the attempted use. Use the coherent 2024 feature package.

openNativeDecisions.question: Should the previously approved 3.5e BASE-CLASS Fiendish Resilience fast healing at class levels 8/13/18 remain as an automatic Warlock grant, become an optional Invocation, or be retired after reviewing 5.x defensive features? No replacement was approved; other historical base-class rulings remain in place.
openNativeDecisions.resolution: Historical 3.5e base Warlock Fiendish Resilience fast healing is NOT an automatic native base Warlock grant. It belongs to one Fiend-only Infernal Retaliation feature, alongside Fiendish Flamewreath ONLY. The feature is granted at Warlock level 8, improves at 13 and 18, and permits one player-chosen Reaction activation per Long Rest of either 20-round effect. At 0 HP while active, fast healing stabilizes once without healing or waking the Warlock; no repeated automatic stabilization. Hellfire Shield is excluded and its acquisition method deferred to Eldritch Invocations pillar. Other historical base-class rulings remain unchanged.

openNativeDecisions.question: How much interchange among different Patrons is permitted and costed? Real multi-Patron validation deferred because only Fiend is in the SRDs.

explicitExclusions: Activating unreconciled mechanics as native rules

patronInitialFiendMilestone.qualification: First grant timing and part identity are approved, as is the 2024 cooperative Blessing trigger; spell grant semantics and exact spell roster remain unresolved.

luckUses.qualification: Owner approved both Charisma-modifier uses and the 2024 Long Rest recovery schedule.

baseEldritchBlast.qualification: Eldritch Blast is automatically granted as a base Warlock class feature at level 1. Exact damage scaling, spell/cantrip count representation, Patron Imprint behavior and Invocation compatibility remain to be reconciled; do not create duplicate grants.

darkOnesBlessing.qualification: Owner approves the 2024 cooperative trigger at the approved native level-1 feature milestone; standard temporary hit points do not stack.

hurlThroughHell.uses: one-per-long-rest; spend a pact-magic spell slot to restore a use
hurlThroughHell.qualification: Owner approved the entire previously proposed SRD 5.2.1-style Hurl Through Hell package.

pending: precise handling of fast healing tick timing while above 0 HP
Flamewreath retaliation damage application against attacks during its duration
Fiend-specific implementation and source-conversion validation; exact shield costs belong to separate optional Hellfire specialization
infernalRetaliation.qualification: One Fiend Patron feature with TWO player-chosen Reaction effects, Fiendish Resilience fast healing and Fiendish Flamewreath. One shared use per Long Rest; acquire at Warlock level 8 and improve at levels 13/18. Each sustained mode lasts 20 rounds. If active fast healing encounters 0 HP, stabilize the Warlock once but do not heal at 0 HP or restore consciousness, and do not automatically restabilize after further damage. Hellfire Shield is REMOVED from this feature and is a separate optional Hellfire specialization candidate, not an automatic Fiend grant. Patron level-10 damage resistance remains distinct. Native feature executable definition is still pending.

activation.clarification: Native Dorks & Dice Reactions do not require a trigger: the player chooses when to activate either eligible effect while a Reaction is available. Activating either mode spends that Reaction and the one shared Infernal Retaliation use per Long Rest; ongoing effects do not consume further Reactions.

historicalEffectScaling.sourceDistinction: Historical 3.5e 1/2/5 fast healing and 1d6/2d6/5d6 Flamewreath tiers inform the approved native two-effect Fiend feature; Hellfire Shield history is separately preserved under optional Hellfire specialization, not the feature.

atZeroHitPoints.clarification: The active resilience effect can stabilize the Warlock when reduced to 0 HP once during that activation, without restoring HP or consciousness. Further damage at 0 HP follows ordinary stabilization/death rules; the feature does not repeatedly stabilize.

shield.name: Hellfire Shield

nativeDamageDesign.qualification: Derived damage reflects current Eldritch Blast and eligible Hellfire modifications; no invented numeric tiers. Eldritch Blast's final attack/beam calculation, Hellfire eligibility, Constitution damage, targeting, and resolution timing remain open.

historicalSource.sourceScaling: one-acquisition-tier; damage scales indirectly with Eldritch Blast including Hellfire Blast enhancement

unresolved: DEFERRED to Eldritch Invocations pillar: select automatic Fiend Patron grant, Fiend Patron feature choice, or Fiend-prerequisite Eldritch Invocation; assign level and entitlement
own resource/cost and original Constitution ability damage
shield.acquisitionRule: Defer acquisition selection to Eldritch Invocations pillar. Preserve three Fiend-only possibilities (automatic Patron grant, Patron choice, or Fiend-prerequisite Invocation), with no grant or resource expenditure selected yet. Whichever mechanism is selected later must use one native Shield ability definition and prevent duplicate entitlements.

hellfireSpecialization.qualification: Owner explicitly defers Hellfire Shield's acquisition method and remaining costs to the Eldritch Invocations pillar. Three Fiend-only routes remain candidate models, not approved grants: Patron automatic grant, Patron choice, and Invocation with Fiend prerequisite. Never count Hellfire Shield as an Infernal Retaliation mode or grant it within the current Fiend Patron package. Its Reaction and derived Eldritch Blast damage direction are preserved for next-pillar review.

implementationNotes: No automatic Hellfire Shield grant; Shield acquisition decision deferred to Invocations pillar
